panels.title: BGP — neighbor map (session state · prefixes · max-prefix)

title: WAN Demo — BGP Neighbor Map
description: BGP neighbor status on a weathermap (#294): routers are nodes, BGP sessions are links. Link status = session Established/down (dashed + ✕ + DOWN + blink on drop); labels = prefixes advertised/received; color = max-prefix fullness (eBGP transits warm as they near the limit). Click a router for its session detail.
